\begin{tikzpicture}[declare function={gocx=75; goc=-40; a=5; d=0.4*a; b=0.25*a; c=0.7*a; h=7;}]
	\path 
	(0,0) coordinate (A)
	(-goc:d) coordinate (E)
	(a,0) coordinate (B)
	(goc:b) coordinate (D)
	(0.5*goc:c) coordinate (C)
	(gocx:h) coordinate (S)
	($(A)!.4!(S)$) coordinate(A')
	($(B)!.4!(S)$) coordinate(B')
	($(C)!.4!(S)$) coordinate(C')
	($(D)!.4!(S)$) coordinate(D')
	($(E)!.4!(S)$) coordinate(E');
	\draw[dashed] (A)--(E)--(B) (E')--(E);
	\draw (D')--(D) (C')--(C) (B')--(E')--(A')--(D')--(C')--(B')--(B)--(C)--(D)--(A)--(A');
	\foreach \x/\goc in {A/-180,E/-90, B/0,C/-60,D/-100,A'/90,E'/90, B'/90,C'/90,D'/90}
	\draw[fill=white] (\x) node[shift={(\goc:7pt)},font=\scriptsize]{$\x$} circle (1pt);\end{tikzpicture}
